full_query: The yeast infection is not transferable?
sentences: Yeast infections, primarily caused by the fungus Candida albicans, are generally not considered highly contagious
However, there are certain circumstances under which they can be transmitted
Sexual Transmission: Yeast infections can be transmitted through sexual contact, although this is relatively uncommon
Both men and women can develop symptoms after sexual intercourse with an infected partner
Mother to Infant: During childbirth, a mother with a vaginal yeast infection can pass the infection to her baby, leading to oral thrush in the infant
Shared Personal Items: In rare cases, sharing personal items like towels or underwear can potentially spread the infection
